newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi one-, three-, six-month t-bill rates fall.
newsitem.headline: Saudi one-, three-, six-month t-bill rates fall.

text.p: Yields dropped at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of treasury bills worth three billion riyals, a banker said on Monday.

The yield on 28-day bills fell to 5.4217 percent from 5.4344 a week ago and the rate on 91-day paper dropped to 5.5392 from 5.6028 percent. The yield on 182-day bills was down at 5.7324 percent from 5.8142.
One-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, three-month funds were at 5-11/16, 9/16 percent and six month deposits were at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent.
